# Office Furniture Brand Websites

Here are some popular office furniture brands and their websites:

## Major Commercial Brands
- **Steelcase** - steelcase.com
- **Herman Miller** - hermanmiller.com
- **Haworth** - haworth.com
- **Knoll** - knoll.com
- **HON** - hon.com
- **Humanscale** - humanscale.com

## Budget-Friendly Options
- **IKEA (Business)** - ikea.com
- **Autonomous** - autonomous.ai
- **FlexiSpot** - flexispot.com
- **Bush Business Furniture** - bushbusinessfurniture.com

## Standing Desk Specialists
- **Uplift Desk** - upliftdesk.com
- **Vari (formerly VariDesk)** - vari.com
- **Fully** - fully.com

## Ergonomic Chair Brands
- **Secretlab** - secretlab.co
- **Branch** - branchfurniture.com
- **Eurotech** - eurotech.com

## Retailers (Multiple Brands)
- **Wayfair** - wayfair.com
- **Office Depot/OfficeMax** - officedepot.com
- **Staples** - staples.com

---
